In detail

Residents organized volunteer night patrols ('Serenos del Putxet') in 2021 after a wave of building break-ins, and Mossos data showed about 40 robberies targeting minors leaving schools in one year. An overnight shooting on Calle Ferran Puig in July 2026 (no injuries) adds to the picture, part of a citywide uptick in gun incidents. These are real but scattered incidents; daytime robberies were specifically linked to school-exit times. Sources checked: metropoliabierta.elespanol.com, 2021; barnadiario.com, Jul 2026.
